title: Khatakshetra Illustrated Library — Proposed Master Catalogue v0.1
status: Editorial roadmap, not a set of completed or verified book manuscripts
method: Source graph -> corpus-specific complete narrative -> book bible -> dialogue and art references -> print production

DM.title: THE DEVI MAHATMYA SAGA
DM.description: A connected illustrated narrative of the 13-chapter Devi Mahatmya, preserving Suratha/Samadhi/Medhas framing and its three great battle cycles.

FEST.title: NAVARATRI & DUSSEHRA READER
FEST.description: Named tradition and temple calendars, not a fabricated universal nine-form daily sequence.

MAT.title: THE MATRIKAS
MAT.description: Source-scoped goddess roster and battlefield story, with comparative iconography and identities kept distinct.

LAL.title: LALITA’S WAR
LAL.description: The chapter-ordered Bhandasura saga, from the ash-origin through battles and Kama’s restoration.

MUD.title: THE EIGHT MUDGALA MANIFESTATIONS
MUD.description: Eight individually sourced full opponent arcs, not eight one-page summaries.

GAN.title: GANESHA PURANA & GANAPATYA WORLDS
GAN.description: Yuga manifestation stories, Ganesha Gita and carefully separated other Ganapati traditions.

MHD.title: TEN MAHAVIDYAS
MHD.description: One grouped origin volume plus ten textual/iconographic form profiles; do not invent a standard battle biography per goddess.

COS.title: DEVI BHAGAVATA & MANIDVIPA
COS.description: Complete battles, teaching dialogue and source-ordered cosmological journey.

NAM.title: THE THOUSAND NAMES OF LALITA
NAM.description: Thematically grouped illustrated name companions plus future searchable 1000-name reference, not 1000 fake stories.

PIT.title: SHAKTI PITHA ATLAS
PIT.description: Narrative origin, competing enumerations and geographically grounded living traditions.

GITA.title: THE MANY GITAS
GITA.description: Distinct complete dialogues and careful comparisons, after initial collection builds readership.

KAL.title: KHATAKSHETRA ORIGINALS
KAL.description: Explicit fictional Kalpana: futuristic Dashamahavidya TEN DIRECTIONS and alternative-Itihasa worlds.
